svg.aria-label: Predicting the 5%: How to Forecast Rare Spikes, and How to Know When You Can't. Two hackathons, one problem: rare spikes that carry most of the cost. Why standard models miss them, a pre-flight check for whether they can be predicted at all, two methods that work when they can, and what happened on real Lahore smog data.
